# Getting Support for Rheo

Welcome to Rheo! We are dedicated to providing support to our community and users.

## 1. Documentation & Troubleshooting

Before opening an issue or asking for assistance, please check our official documentation:
- **README Guide**: [Rheo Overview](https://github.com/MasterZ1311/Rheo#readme)
- **REST & MCP API Documentation**: [docs/API.md](https://github.com/MasterZ1311/Rheo/blob/MZ-Main/docs/API.md)
- **Troubleshooting Guide**: [docs/content/docs/overview/troubleshooting.mdx](https://github.com/MasterZ1311/Rheo/blob/MZ-Main/docs/content/docs/overview/troubleshooting.mdx)

## 2. GitHub Discussions

For general questions, model recommendations, hardware setups, or sharing your creations:
- **Q&A**: Ask how-to questions about voice cloning or GPU setup.
- **Ideas & Show and Tell**: Share workflows with Claude Code, Cursor, or your personal setups.

👉 **[Join GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/MasterZ1311/Rheo/discussions)**

## 3. GitHub Issues

Please reserve GitHub Issues for actionable bugs and verified feature requests:
- **Bug Reports**: If something is broken, crashes, or produces unexpected errors. Please check existing issues first.
- **Feature Requests**: Well-defined proposals for new TTS engines, UI features, or MCP capabilities.

👉 **[Open an Issue](https://github.com/MasterZ1311/Rheo/issues/new/choose)**

## 4. Security Inquiries

For security vulnerabilities or private security concerns, please refer to our [Security Policy](.github/SECURITY.md) and do not post publicly on GitHub.
